content: Purposefully, there are 63 duplicates between the normal reading and the task-specific sentences (8% of all sentences). The intention of these duplicate sentences is to provide a set of sentences read twice by all participants with a different task in mind. Hence, this enables the comparison of eye-tracking and brain activity data when reading normally and when annotating specific relations (see examples in Section SECREF4).
